name: Creative Toy
description: A calm, open-ended drawing toy. Leave soft marks with the keyboard or the mouse; a toy pack sets the colours and the style of the marks.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A quiet canvas where you leave marks. A toy pack decides the colours, the style and any mirroring.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Make something, or just move the cursor around.
howToPlay: Click the canvas to leave a mark, or drag to draw a trail.
With the keyboard, focus the canvas, move with the arrow keys and press Space to place a mark.
Pick a colour with the number keys or the round swatches.
Press Undo to take the last mark back, or Clear to start over.

controls.action: Move the cursor (hold Shift for bigger steps)
Clear the canvas (Undo brings it back)

tips: Your picture is saved on this device when you pause. Nothing is uploaded and it cannot be exported.
The canvas keeps up to 2000 marks; the oldest fade away after that.
